executable_actions.rationale: Promote the accepted Stage-3 pipeline plan into the Stage-4 handoff. executable_actions.on_failure: Return unresolved parameters to Stage-4 DSE with the specific template or checker mismatch; do not alter Stage-3 operator order, numeric policy, or stream/data edge contracts.
executable_actions.rationale: Stage 4 must bind final per-template parameters from the accepted pipeline contract. executable_actions.on_failure: Keep Stage-5 memory layout blocked until symbolic region handles replace unverified concrete addresses and all listed checkers pass; do not guess wrapper or ABI names.
executable_actions.rationale: Convert board-supplied XDMA/DDR base and output-address hints into symbolic region handles and assign concrete aligned bases only after exact board-wrapper discovery. This preserves board AXI/XDMA hooks and complies with the Stage-3 deferral boundary.

targeted_replay_plan.preserve: board_axi width/protocol facts, required_regions roles, double-buffered weights and streamed activations policy, target_seq_len compile-time bound

proposed_actions: Stage 4 DSE: bind final per-template parameters from this contract, including lanes and compute-array candidate values, without changing the checker-backed operator order, shapes, numeric policy, or stream contracts.

Stage 5 memory layout: replace concrete XDMA/DDR base and output-address values in runtime_config_requirements with symbolic region handles and assign aligned addresses only after exact board-wrapper discovery.

Stage 6+ verification planning: schedule bottom-up VCS compile-only evidence for operator leaves, the connected single-transformer-layer kernel, and the exact discovered board wrapper; do not claim numerical/runtime/board pass from Stage 3.
Preserve pre-DUT learned absolute position composition and keep embedding/tokenization, final model norm, LM head/logits, and sampling outside DUT weight coverage and golden acceptance boundaries.
